answer_1.quote: Open-domain dialogue generation has gained considerable traction in the field of natural language generation ... The goal is to generate a response Y = {y1 , y2 , ..., ym } by modeling the conditional probability distribution P (Y |X, G).

answer_2.quote: We follow ... adopting the metrics of perplexity (PPL) and Entity Score (ES), and follow ... adopting BLEU, NIST, METEOR, Dist, and Ent, where the Entity Score measures the average number of entities per response and others measure the quality of generated responses.

answer_4.quote: Pair-wise comparisons are conducted with the most competitive baseline and the ablation model by five evaluators giving their preference of response on 100 randomly collected samples, regarding two aspects: the appropriateness (whether the response is appropriate in the context) and informativeness (whether the response contains new information).
answer_4.guideline: Evaluators performed pair‑wise comparisons, choosing which response was better with respect to appropriateness and informativeness.
